lat: tabe3ti d-derasa dyalek l-3am lli fat
ar: تابعتي الدراسة ديالك العام اللي فات
en: You continued your studies last year.
They continue their studies at the university.

lat: ghadi ntab3u d-derasa mn ba3d s-sif
ar: غادي نتابعو الدراسة من بعد الصيف
en: We're going to continue our studies after the summer.
